entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Sarah, I want to return this garbage jersey I bought. This is unbelievable. I spend good money and you send me something a child couldn't even fit into. I want my money back, now!

I'm very sorry to hear you're unhappy with the fit. I can certainly look into this for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue with the sizing?

Are you kidding me? It's the wrong size! It's way too tight! I can barely breathe in it. I need to exchange this thing or get a refund. This is ridiculous. If this isn't sorted out in five minutes, I'm lighting you up on every review site on the planet!
I understand your frustration, and I want to get this resolved for you quickly. Do you have your order number handy? I just need to pull up the purchase details.
Ugh, fine. It's VF8675309. You'd better be able to do something, or I want to speak to your manager. I'm not playing games.

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the Pro-Line jersey, delivered 10 days ago. That's no problem at all. That item falls under our 90-day return policy, so you are well within the window for a full refund or an exchange.
Wait, really? So you can just... take it back?

Yes, absolutely. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label right now. You can use that to send the jersey back for a full refund. If you'd prefer an exchange for a larger size, you can select that option right from the return link in the email.
Oh. Okay. I see the email. Well... that was easier than I thought. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's it. Thank you, Sarah.
Great. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
